# Bede by Agnus Dei

> Bede by Agnus Dei Technologies, LLC is a human-led classical learning platform for K-8 homeschooling families, co-ops, and classical educators, supporting learners ages 5–15. It combines lesson planning, Socratic AI-assisted practice, and learning records to support reading, writing, mathematics, and applying knowledge.

Parents and educators choose the books, curriculum, and goals, guide the learning, and review the work. Bede supports inquiry, explanation, and thoughtful application. Faith and character are never scored.

The public demo is cloud-hosted. Self-hosted and offline installations are separately configured; local-only privacy applies to offline installations. School demonstrations are teacher-directed and use synthetic data; real learner data and direct tutoring require separate qualification and a signed scope.

## Product and audiences

- [Bede home](https://agnusdei.ai/): Product overview, human-led learning, and the two offers.
- [Homeschooling families](https://agnusdei.ai/homeschool/): Family-led learning, outcomes, onboarding, and the current family offer.
- [Co-op educators](https://agnusdei.ai/educators/): Co-op readiness, implementation, and family participation.
- [Classical schools and charters](https://agnusdei.ai/schools/): Teacher-directed pilots, current school scope, licensing, and implementation.

## See and try Bede

- [Bede overview and lesson demonstrations](https://agnusdei.ai/bede/tour/): Videos and an interactive introduction to Bede.
- [Public Bede demo](https://agnusdei.ai/bede/): Explore the hosted demo using fictional examples; separate from an onboarded installation.

## Policies and inquiries

- [Frequently asked questions](https://agnusdei.ai/faq/): Teaching approach, curriculum, setup, offers, and limitations. Bede does not administer or score DIBELS assessments.
- [Privacy and data disclosure](https://agnusdei.ai/privacy/): Website forms, hosted-demo storage, external services, and data choices.
- [Research](https://agnusdei.ai/research/): Research context and evidence boundaries.
- [Request onboarding or information](https://agnusdei.ai/inquire/): Discuss family, co-op, or school needs. Do not submit student records or sensitive information.

Learn about Bede sessions: bede@agnusdei.ai. Educator, co-op, and family onboarding inquiries: info@agnusdei.ai.
